sectionTitleHi: लोन और क्रेडिट कार्ड रेफरल अनुभाग (गैर-सरकारी वाणिज्यिक सेवाएँ)
disclosure: This section is strictly separate from government jobs and Sarkari Yojana. Listings below are commercial banking and credit products offered by RBI-regulated banks and NBFCs. Always verify interest rates, APR, processing fees, and terms on the official bank portal before applying.
disclosureHi: यह अनुभाग सरकारी नौकरी व सरकारी योजनाओं से पूरी तरह अलग है। यहाँ केवल RBI-विनियमित बैंकों/संस्थाओं के वाणिज्यिक ऋण और क्रेडिट कार्ड उत्पाद सूचीबद्ध हैं। आवेदन से पहले ब्याज दर, प्रोसेसिंग शुल्क और नियम आधिकारिक बैंक वेबसाइट पर अवश्य जाँचें।

items.name: PM-Vidyalaxmi Portal (Govt. Interest Subvention Comparison)
items.provider: Department of Financial Services / Participating Banks
items.highlights: Collateral-free education loans for QHEIs; 3% interest subvention for eligible families up to ₹8 lakh annual income.
items.eligibility: Merit-based admission in eligible higher education institutions.

items.name: SBI Scholar / Student Education Loan
items.highlights: Covers tuition, hostel, books, and exam fees for domestic & abroad studies; transparent public sector bank rates.
items.eligibility: Indian nationals with confirmed admission in recognized Indian/foreign institutions.

items.name: HDFC Bank Personal Loan
items.highlights: Unsecured personal financing for salaried and self-employed applicants; digital KYC available for eligible borrowers.
items.eligibility: Age 21–60 years with stable verifiable monthly income and valid KYC.

items.name: ICICI Bank / JanSamarth MSME Credit
items.highlights: Working capital and term loans for registered MSMEs and professionals; compare with Mudra/PMEGP government schemes.
items.eligibility: Registered business entity with GST/ITR/bank statements as per lender norms.

categories.title: Credit Cards (Cashback, Fuel & Student)
categories.titleHi: क्रेडिट कार्ड (कैशबैक, फ्यूल व छात्र कार्ड)

items.name: SBI Cashback Credit Card
items.highlights: Online & offline spend cashback benefits subject to monthly caps and issuer schedule of charges.
items.eligibility: Salaried or self-employed individuals meeting SBI Card income & CIBIL norms.

items.name: RuPay UPI Credit Card (Entry / Utility)
items.highlights: Linkable to UPI apps for merchant QR payments with interest-free billing cycle (verify annual fee waiver rules).
items.eligibility: Indian residents meeting issuing bank KYC and credit eligibility.
